It updates the proxy management system to remove old proxies matching the base JID and IP/port pair before inserting new ones, ensuring that duplicate entries for the same remote peer are overwritten and connection retry data is refreshed.

The code also requests certificates on every connection attempt to account for potential remote peer restarts and new certificate generation.
